rationale: Each rule in ci-surface-rules.json is listed here against the fixture that must trigger it. A rule with no entry has never fired and is not evidence of anything.
unfired_rules_note: SEEDED_CONTROL_REMOVED, SEEDED_CONTROL_WEAKENED, WARM_BYTECODE_CACHE, UNDECLARED_TRACKED_BYTECODE and STALE_BYTECODE_EXCEPTION are not workflow-text rules, so they are proved in test_a3_ci_clean_clone.py against synthetic trees rather than against a fixture file here.
